_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Safety Studies Report
summary: Provides the Navy with a means to evaluate the safety being designed into the equipment, verify that the design satisfies Navy safety criteria, identify design features that could create hazard conditions, and identify safety related interface considerations.
description_purpose:
Provides the Navy with a means to evaluate the safety being designed into the equipment.

Used to verify that the system/subsystem or component design approach satisfies established Navy Safety design criteria.

Used to identify specific design features which could create hazard conditions.

Used to identify safety related interface considerations.
application_interrelationship:
This Data Item Description contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.

This DID supersedes UDI-H-23385.

This DID is to be used in conjunction with DI-SAFT-81066.

NAVSEAINSTR 8020.6 may be obtained from Commander, Naval Sea Systems Command, Attn: Code 09P21, Washington, DC 20362.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Safety Studies Report shall be typed in the contractor's format on 8 1/2" by 11" sheets.

preparation_instructions.title: Contents
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall contain a complete description of the safety studies. The key conclusions and recommendations shall be summarized in accordance with the latest version of NAVSEAINSTR 8020.6; Navy Weapon System Safety Program.
